name: Serge Gracq
source:
The person who invited the protagonist to Mirage Island.

He is also the general manager of Hotel Azur.
Having assumed the role about a year ago, they still appear somewhat
unaccustomed to the job.

Serge was close with the protagonist's grandmother during her lifetime.
